t: ff.49 The pandemic of the 21st century
st: Why are we getting ever more obese? Doritos, physical activity or pollution?

sec.p: Nutrition and diet are a complex topic, hard to unpack in a newsletter, also given the non-trivial connections between:

These charts, though on different scales, remind me terribly of those from February 2020. In a (post-)COVID era, can we talk about another, quieter and slower pandemic? If so, what is the “obesity virus”?
We've seen the trends and laid the groundwork for measuring our bodies. Now let's try to understand why we're getting ever rounder.

sec.t: ff.49.4 The superman who takes 100 pills a day
sec.p: The record for reversing epigenetic ageing (5 years). Some people have taken diet care to the extreme (ranking first in the Rejuvenation Olympics).
